text: Laoshan Cola (崂山可乐) is operated by Qingdao Beverage Group Co., Ltd., a Qingdao municipal state-owned enterprise. The group's Laoshan Mineral Water subsidiary produces and markets Laoshan Cola, and the subsidiary's 'Laoshan' brand signed the Qingdao Hainiu shirt sponsorship.
short: Laoshan Cola is a brand of state-owned Qingdao Beverage Group.

source.name: Sohu (九五体育sport95): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商 (The three industries sponsoring CSL clubs' shirt fronts)
source.quote: 崂山可乐由青岛饮料集团有限公司运营，而该集团是青岛市属国有企业
source.note: Translation: 'Laoshan Cola is operated by Qingdao Beverage Group Co., Ltd., and that group is a Qingdao municipal state-owned enterprise.'

additionalSources.name: 青岛政务网 (Qingdao Municipal Government portal, source 青岛日报/Qingdao Daily): 青岛饮料集团持续做强品牌影响力 10款产品焕新上市
additionalSources.quote: 青岛饮料集团旗下崂矿公司生产线从2日开始又恢复了往常的忙碌。崂山可乐、崂山白花蛇草水、瓶装水、桶装水等产品有序地从一条条生产线上下线
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Production lines at Qingdao Beverage Group's Laoshan Mineral Water subsidiary resumed on the 2nd. Laoshan Cola, Laoshan Baihua Snake Grass Water, bottled water and other products rolled off the lines' — i.e. the group's subsidiary makes Laoshan Cola.

additionalSources.name: 青岛日报社/观海新闻 (Qingdao Daily / dailyqd.com): 百年匠心致敬绿茵，崂山可乐携手青岛海牛足球俱乐部共启2026新赛季
additionalSources.quote: 青岛崂山矿泉水有限公司与俱乐部正式签署赞助协议，旗下“崂山”品牌将成为球队新赛季官方赞助商
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Qingdao Laoshan Mineral Water Co., Ltd. formally signed the sponsorship agreement with the club; its Laoshan brand will become the team's official sponsor for the new season.'
